name: Water Damage Restoration
summary: Complete reconstruction and build-back after water losses caused by plumbing leaks, roof leaks, appliance failures and storm-related water intrusion, once the property has been stabilized and properly dried.

faqs.question: Do you provide emergency water extraction?
faqs.answer: Our primary service is reconstruction and build-back after the source has been stopped and the property has been professionally stabilized and dried.

faqs.question: What parts of a home can be restored after water damage?
faqs.answer: Depending on the approved scope, restoration can include drywall, ceilings, insulation, texture, paint, baseboards, doors, cabinets, engineered wood, laminate, tile and other interior finishes.

faqs.question: Can you coordinate several damaged trades in one project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Luna General Contractors can coordinate the reconstruction sequence across drywall, carpentry, painting, flooring, cabinets and related repairs so the affected rooms are rebuilt as one organized project.

faqs.question: Can you work from an insurance estimate?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review the repair scope, identify missing or unclear reconstruction items and prepare a detailed estimate for the approved build-back work. Coverage decisions remain with the property owner and insurance carrier.
